Hand-made inputs for `test/calibration.test.py`. Team codes and scores are invented; nothing here is real data.
`games.csv` has the nflverse columns `scripts/calibration.py` reads. Games P1-P4, G0 and G1 are played on or before
the first snapshot's date; G4 is a tie; G5 is unplayed; G9 appears twice (ambiguous); G10 has no date.
`snapshots/2026-09-11.json` is deliberately malformed.
